name: guided-pointer
title: Guided pointer
description: An illustrated pointer moves between story waypoints, with a small arrival or hold cue.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Omit to use the first valid point. An unknown ID hides the pointer.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds per move, capped at two seconds.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change to repeat a finite arrival cue at the current waypoint.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph size in pixels. Coordinates use the stage area minus this size.
